title: Inverse-pullback comparison for a commuting automorphism square
statement: Let P,Q be schemes, A a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category, j:Q≅P, a:P≅P, b:Q≅Q. Suppose b.hom j.hom=j.hom a.hom and j.inv b.inv=a.inv j.inv. For every pro-etale A-sheaf M on P, the pullback compositor for (b,j), followed by b.hom^* of the canonical comparison for j, the canonical comparison for b, and the lower-star exchange for the inverse square, equals the pullback congruence of the given hom equality, the compositor for (j,a), j.hom^* of the canonical comparison for a, and the canonical comparison for j. No Weil structure or iterated Frobenius map is part of this statement. Equivalently, the two natural transformations from (b.hom ≫ j.hom)^* to a.inv_* composed with j.inv_* are equal.

proof.text: Keep a common composite isomorphism E abstract and apply the factorisation-form comparison square.

Use the existing upperStarCompIso_eq_upperStarFactor to identify the complete pullback square with the inverse first upper-star factor followed by the second. On components, multiply by the first factor to express the second factor in this form. Substitute in the exchange equality and cancel the common invertible first factor. Precompose by the first pullback compositor. First cancel its inverse in upperStarCompIso at the natural-transformation level and then evaluate at M; this gives the compositor identity without expensive componentwise conversion. Substitute this identity to obtain the displayed square. E remains abstract through cancellation. The public theorem then supplies b followed by j as the common composite, before specialization to a carrier comparison. The component calculation gives equality of natural transformations by extensionality; the transport application specializes this identity before evaluating at a sheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem upperStarIsoLowerStarInv_exchange (A : Type v) [Category.{u + 1} A]
    [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} A] {P Q : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : Q ≅ P) (a : P ≅ P) (b : Q ≅ Q)
    (hc : b.hom ≫ j.hom = j.hom ≫ a.hom)
    (hi : j.inv ≫ b.inv = a.inv ≫ j.inv) :
    (upperStarComp A b.hom j.hom).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (upperStarIsoLowerStarInv A j).hom (b.hom)^*[A] ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (j.inv)_*[A] (upperStarIsoLowerStarInv A b).hom ≫
      (lowerStarFactor A hi).hom ≫
      (lowerStarFactor A (rfl : a.inv ≫ j.inv = a.inv ≫ j.inv)).inv =
    (upperStarCongr A hc).hom ≫ (upperStarComp A j.hom a.hom).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (upperStarIsoLowerStarInv A a).hom (j.hom)^*[A] ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (a.inv)_*[A] (upperStarIsoLowerStarInv A j).hom
